meta.title: Line-Item Assignment Rule Engine: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Verify that the Line-Item Assignment Rule Engine is absent or refused on a tenant below the Growth plan.
Use the Line-Item Assignment Rule Engine to auto-assign PR line items by category, location, and value rules.
Repeat the same rule-engine workflow on a Growth tenant and verify that it works.
Compare the same user's access across lower-plan and Growth tenants because no tenant IDs or plan-switching setup are provided.
